headline: AMBER: SPI 0.91 and CPI 0.97 at the end of week 3
summary: The library app is slightly behind plan but close to budget. Most of the slip sits in one critical task.
schedule: An SPI of 0.91 means less work is done than planned, mainly because T04 Catalogue search API is 40% done against 80% planned and is on the critical path.
cost: A CPI of 0.97 means work is costing a little more than budgeted; the EAC of ₹3.10 lakh is above the BAC of ₹3.00 lakh, a VAC of -₹0.10 lakh.
issues: T04 Catalogue search API is behind plan and on the critical path.
T06 Barcode scanning is 50% done against 70% planned.
actions: Developer lead to pair a second developer on T04 this week.
R02: tester to start test cases for T06 in parallel, as planned in the risk response.
